about.title: About this page
about.intro: Keres is a tool for planning stories: characters, chapters, scenes, locations, items, world rules, and how they all connect. This page is the public face of one Keres server - a place where the people writing on it can put a story where anyone can see it.
about.downloadBody: Each published version is a complete package of a story's Keres base: its structure and everything written around it, plus the media the author attached. It is not the story as a finished work - Keres is always a companion to whatever the story is actually being made in, whether that is a novel, a game, or a campaign.
about.importBody: Open a package in Keres through Import / Export. Importing makes a separate copy on your device; it does not join the author's story or send anything back to them.
about.responsibilityBody: The stories here belong to the people who published them, and this server is run by whoever chose to run it. Keres, the application, is not affiliated with either, does not host or moderate these stories, and takes no position on them.

footer.disclaimer: Keres is a writing companion for planning stories. It is not affiliated with the server hosting this page, nor with the stories published on it, and it does not endorse or moderate them. Every story here belongs to the person who published it.

gate.title: This story is private
gate.intro: Its author published it without listing it. Enter the password they gave you to open the page.

home.title: Stories, laid open.
home.intro: Every story below was written in Keres and published here by its author. Open one to read what it is about, then download the whole thing - characters, chapters, scenes, locations and all - and open it in your own copy of Keres.
home.empty: Nothing has been published on this server yet. When an author publishes a story, it shows up here.

pack.author: Author
pack.contentsIntro: Everything this pack carries is listed here. There is nothing else to unlock.
pack.howtoBody: In Keres, add this server under your account, then pick the pack when creating a story. Its structure is applied to the new story and is yours to change from there.

packs.title: Packs on this server
packs.intro: A pack is the reusable shape of a story - custom fields, stat axes, tag sets, suggestion lists - offered for anyone to start a new story with. It carries no characters, no scenes and no prose: nobody's story travels in one.
packs.empty: Nobody has shared a pack here yet.

story.author: Author
story.downloadIntro: Each version is a complete Keres package - the story and its media - that imports straight back into the app.
